definitions: Balances are current for invoices issued within the selected date cohort.
Submitted collections are excluded from collected funds until verified.
Reminder payment association does not prove delivery or causation.
limits: Generation follows existing member-based club/category plans; no new direct organizational debtor or per-unit accounting model was introduced.
Reviewed generation accepts up to 500 assessments; full-plan generation uses the existing background job without page exclusions. Drafts are local browser drafts.
Notifications use existing finance notification channels; no new WhatsApp, mail-delivery or payment provider was added.
Proof uses existing references or secure links, rather than a new upload provider.
Fixed, percentage and full credits are supported; automatic early-payment discount rules were not introduced.
Legacy reports and exports retain a 20000-row bound. Bank candidates are bounded at 200 and matched history at 50.
Performance checks cover QA-scale data, not a million-row benchmark.
navigation: ID cards and Intelligence remain separate main menu items, outside Finance.
